name: w2e-disposable-runner-invariance
title: Land the disposable-workspace runner and four-tuple net-state invariance (spec section 2)
description: Implements section 2 of the trusted RED-evidence subsystem spec: every RED and GREEN run executes in a disposable detached git worktree, with a four-tuple (headHash, materialHash, indexState, gitStatus) captured immediately before the command starts and immediately after it exits. A run may produce a record only if all four compare byte-identical. Three of the four carry single normative definitions the spec pins because earlier revisions got them wrong - materialHash calls the existing currentMaterialHash rather than re-deriving it, indexState is the git write-tree object id verbatim rather than a hash over ls-files, and gitStatus is filtered by a rename-aware byte-level entry rule rather than line-wise. The claim is NET-STATE invariance and the spec forbids describing it as proof of zero mid-run writes.
source: Program Workstream 2, spec section 2; follows B-9ff1 (W2d, section 1) DONE 2026-08-19
